definitions.short: (plural for collective) a footpiece , i.e. (adverbially) at the foot , or (direct.) the foot itself
definitions.full: H4772. margeloth [ מַרְגְּלוֺת ] noun [feminine] plural denominative place of the feet, feet (compare [ מְרַאֲשׁוֺת ] below I. ראשׁ ); &; suffix מַרְגְּםתָיו place of his feet Ruth 3:4 , 7 ; adverb = at his feet 3:8 + 3:14 Qr (Kt מרגלתו ); = his feet Dan 10:6 (opposed to זְרֹעֹתָיו ).
